سیلو دان و سیستم انتقال دان مرغداری | طی: Feed silos and feed conveying systems | Toyooran Sanat Pouya
سیلو ذخیره دان، خط انتقال دان اوگر و آسی: Feed storage silos, auger feed conveying lines and grinder-mixers for poultry houses. Technical inquiries to Toyooran Sanat Pouya.
این دسته سیلو و سیستم انتقال دان مرغداری: This category covers poultry farm silos and feed conveying systems, from storage into the house. Feed is stored in the silo, carried by the auger conveying line to the house hopper, and from there enters the feeder lines. If feed is prepared on the farm, a grinder, mixer and elevator are added to this chain. The three products in this category are these three links.
**سیلو ذخیره‌ی دان:** سیلوی پیچ و مهره‌ا: **Feed storage silo:** a bolted silo of corrugated galvanised sheet, standard capacity 2.5 to 30 tonnes and custom capacity up to 100 tonnes, on 4 to 10 tubular legs. It has a caged ladder, an inspection window and a lever for opening the top hatch from the ground. Assembly and disassembly are simple.
**سیستم انتقال دان:** خط انتقال با اوگر: **Feed conveying system:** a conveying line with a steel spring auger inside a wear-resistant tube that carries feed from the silo to the house hoppers. A capacitive sensor at the end of the line stops it when the hopper is full.
**آسیاب، میکسر و بالابر:** مجموعه‌ی تهیه: **Grinder, mixer and elevator:** an on-farm feed preparation set with a hammer or roller mill, a vertical or horizontal mixer and a screw elevator, in capacities of 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 tonnes per hour.
اندازه‌ی سیلو و طول خط انتقال از مصرف دا: The silo size and conveying line length follow from the house feed consumption and the interval between feed deliveries. For an estimate, the specialist needs this information:
تعداد سالن‌ها و ظرفیت هر سالن در هر دوره: Number of houses and the capacity of each house per cycle
نوع پرورش: گوشتی، تخمگذار یا مادر: Rearing type: broiler, layer or breeder
فاصله‌ی محل سیلو تا سالن و جای ورودی خط: Distance from the silo site to the house and where the line enters the house
دان آماده خریداری می‌شود یا در فارم تهیه: Whether feed is bought ready-made or prepared on the farm
وضعیت زمین محل نصب سیلو و دسترسی کامیون: Ground conditions at the silo site and access for the feed truck
برق در دسترس برای موتور خط انتقال و، در: Power available for the conveying line motor and, if needed, the grinder and mixer
خط انتقال باید با سیستم دانخوری داخل سال: The conveying line must be matched to the feeding system inside the house. For feeder pans and lines, see the [feeder pans](/products/feeding) category. For a complete house design, see the [poultry house fit-out and renovation](/services/poultry-hall-fitout) page.
تعداد و ظرفیت سالن‌ها و فاصله‌ی سیلو تا: Send the number and capacity of the houses and the silo-to-house distance through the [contact form](/contact), and a specialist will review the silo size and conveying line route.
قفس مرغداری تخمگذار، گوشتی و پولت | طیور: Layer, broiler and pullet cages | Toyooran Sanat Pouya
قفس باتری مرغ تخمگذار، قفس مرغ گوشتی، قف: Layer battery cages, broiler cages, pullet cages and automatic nests. Technical inquiries to Toyooran Sanat Pouya.
قفس مرغداری برای سالن‌هایی است که پرورش: Poultry cages are for houses where birds are reared on several tiers with automatic feed, water, manure and collection lines. This category includes four systems: layer battery cages, broiler cages, pullet cages and fully automatic breeder nests. Each is designed for one rearing stage or type and they are not interchangeable.
**قفس مرغ تخمگذار (باتری):** قفس تمام مک: **Layer cage (battery):** a fully mechanised cage with an egg collection conveyor, a polypropylene manure belt and automatic feeder and nipple drinker lines. From 3 to 12 tiers, with a 50 cm aluminium conveyor belt.
**قفس مرغ گوشتی:** سیستم تمام اتوماتیک ب: **Broiler cage:** a fully automatic system with a flexible polymer floor, horizontal and vertical conveyors for unloading birds at the end of the cycle, two pan feeder lines per cell and a PP manure belt.
**قفس پولت:** برای دوره‌ی پرورش پولت تخم: **Pullet cage:** for rearing layer pullets, with a galvanised, electrostatically painted body, 60 cm leg spacing and four steel nipples per cell.
**آشیانه‌ی تمام اتوماتیک:** لانه‌ی تخمگذ: **Fully automatic nest:** a laying nest for breeders and floor rearing, with a PP collection belt whose speed is set by an inverter and plastic slats of 60×120 and 60×100 cm.
انتخاب قفس از نوع پرورش شروع می‌شود، نه: Cage selection starts from the rearing type, not the product model. For an estimate, the specialist usually asks for this information:
نوع پرورش و مرحله‌ی گله: تخمگذار، گوشتی،: Rearing type and flock stage: layer, broiler, pullet or breeder
طول، عرض و ارتفاع مفید سالن، چون تعداد ر: Usable length, width and height of the house, as they set the number of rows and tiers
وضعیت کف و سازه برای تحمل بار قفس و تجهی: Floor and structure condition for carrying the cage and equipment load
برنامه‌ی تخلیه‌ی کود و مسیر انتقال تخم‌م: Manure removal plan and the route for taking eggs or birds out of the house
وضعیت تهویه و برق فعلی، چون پرورش چندطبق: Current ventilation and power, as multi-tier rearing moves more air in less volume
قفس جدا از بقیه‌ی سالن کار نمی‌کند. خط د: A cage does not work in isolation from the rest of the house. Feed, water, ventilation and heating lines must be designed to match the cage layout. For a new fit-out or renovation, the [poultry house fit-out and renovation](/services/poultry-hall-fitout) page explains the whole process.
ابعاد سالن، نوع پرورش و ظرفیت مدنظر را ا: Send the house dimensions, rearing type and target capacity through the [contact form](/contact), and a specialist will review the right system and a proposed layout.

بیشتر تجهیزات سالن مرغداری در دسته‌های ا: Most poultry house equipment is in the site's main categories: [heating](/products/heating), [ventilation](/products/ventilation), [cooling](/products/cooling), [inlets](/products/inlet), [drinkers](/products/drinking) and [feeder pans](/products/feeding). This category is for items and packages that do not fit one of those categories or combine several systems.
**سیستم تهویه تونلی مرغداری:** پکیج تهوی: **Poultry tunnel ventilation system:** a tunnel and cross ventilation package for poultry houses. The package fans are 140×140 cm with a galvanised sheet body, steel propeller and centrifugal shutter. The shutter stays closed when the fan is off and keeps outside air out.
اگر قطعه یا دستگاهی را که لازم دارید در: If a part or machine is not in this category or the main categories, that does not mean it cannot be supplied. The site list does not show every item. Include these details in the inquiry so a specialist can review it faster:
نام یا کاربرد تجهیز و، اگر دارید، مدل یا: The equipment name or use and, if available, the model or a photo of the current unit
این‌که تجهیز برای سالن نو است یا جایگزین: Whether the equipment is for a new house or replaces an existing unit
برق و سوخت در دسترس محل: Power and fuel available on site
تجهیز تکی وقتی درست کار می‌کند که با بقی: A single piece of equipment only works properly when matched to the other house systems. An extra fan without matching inlets and controls may not solve a ventilation problem. That is why the specialist may also ask about the rest of the house equipment.
The site's product list is being completed gradually. Whenever new equipment that does not fit the main categories is added, it appears on this page. Until then, a direct inquiry is the fastest route.
